segments.title: Cold Open & Technical Difficulties
segments.notes: Pepito delivers sign-on as 'Papita the dog'; OBS and Stream Deck malfunction forces intro replay; chat overlay broken until intro re-triggers.

segments.title: Charlie Kirk Assassination & Political Violence Discourse
segments.notes: Case reacts to Charlie Kirk shooting on campus; argues violence creates martyrs and fuels authoritarian crackdowns; Jeff Ripple concurs; chat debates violence ethics.

segments.title: Political Satire Is Dead Rant
segments.notes: Case monologues on collapse of Daily Show-era political comedy; compares to Tim Dillon, Jerry Seinfeld; concludes 'piss news' is only viable mode.

segments.title: Wall Stream Delayed to Next Friday
segments.notes: Case announces crawlspace/Wall stream pushed from 9/11 to next Friday due to guest scheduling; will stream normal show tomorrow 2 PM; Patreon Thursday unchanged.

segments.title: Viewer Videos & Peter Gibbon Intrusion
segments.notes: Stand-up clips, mobile ad parody, TikTok strategy ad, BTS fancam, shake-the-juice joke, disturbing 'sacred object' video, squirrel assault clip, Disney coral parade float, motocross mountain run; Peter Gibbon teleports in, claims wall residency, argues with Case.

segments.title: Interstellar Object 3I Atlas, AI Seinfeld, Mars Life Hints
segments.notes: Chet joins; discusses carbon-rich interstellar comet 3I Atlas; 'Watch Me Forever' AI Seinfeld still streaming to 4 viewers; NASA Perseverance finds potential ancient microbe biosignatures; Jerry Seinfeld compares Free Palestine to KKK.

segments.title: Epstein Birthday Book Deep Dive
segments.notes: Case, Chet, Peter read PDF of Epstein's contact book: Trump drawing with signature-as-bush, letters from children, Leon Black sexual assault 'joke', Robin Kill victim entry; Case calls executive stop — too dark.

segments.title: OpenAI Animated Feature Film Announcement
segments.notes: OpenAI partners with London/LA studios for AI-generated feature; Case predicts unwatchable trash; chat suggests anthropomorphic penis movie.

segments.title: Drunk Raccoon CPR Rescue
segments.notes: Kentucky nurse Misty Combs revives 'Otis' the raccoon after fermented peach drowning; CPR on camera; reunited with mother; Case declares best news of the day.

segments.title: Rob Elvie Returns Claiming Reform
segments.notes: Previously banned caller Rob Elvie appears live; generic apology over sad music; Case unconvinced, cuts him off.

segments.title: Debate: Is Murder Wrong Always?
segments.notes: Munch (skeleton) argues murder always wrong; Crum (voice-modulated off Biden) defends pro-murder side via Plato quotes; voice modulator cycles through Sonic, smooth villain, Elden Ring NPC; Munch sings 'Sexy Boy'; Case ends stream.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Wall Stream Confirmation
segments.notes: Case wraps; confirms Wall stream next Friday; tomorrow 2 PM normal stream; Pepito struggles with credits; OBS glitches on exit.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored breaking news on Charlie Kirk assassination, ranted on political satire collapse, delayed Wall stream, moderated Amongst the Web and Epstein book reading, ended on Munch & Crum debate.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open as 'Papita the dog'; managed broken OBS/Stream Deck; cued intro replays; struggled with credits at close.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debated Munch on 'murder wrong always' with voice modulator stripping Biden voice; quoted Plato, sang 'Sexy Boy', threatened wall breakthrough.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Skeleton form argued murder always wrong; sang 'Sexy Boy', mocked Crum's voice changes, claimed credit for rescuing Crum from hell.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Teleported into Amongst the Web, claimed wall omnipotence, argued with Case over Wall stream scheduling, demanded song playback.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Joined for Chet Guy the Science Eyes: covered 3I Atlas comet, AI Seinfeld status, Mars biosignatures; played 'Say Less' AI game with Sick McBurger.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Briefly concurred with Case on violence/martyrdom during Charlie Kirk segment; otherwise off-mic.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Referenced as Case's partner who enforces sleep schedule; won Employee of the Month poll in absentia; not on camera.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covers the on-campus assassination of Charlie Kirk, with Case Blackwell arguing the killing will be weaponized for authoritarian crackdowns. The broadcast veers from a eulogy for political satire into a chaotic Amongst the Web block interrupted by wall-dweller Peter Gibbon, a science desk featuring an interstellar carbon comet and the undead AI Seinfeld, and a harrowing read-through of Jeffrey Epstein's contact book. The episode closes with a Munch & Crum debate on whether murder is always wrong — Crum's voice stripped of its Biden timbre — and Case confirming the long-delayed Wall stream for next Friday.
